event: The rupiah closed at Rp18,245 per US dollar on 16 November (Refinitiv), weaker 0.30% from Rp18,190, after touching an intraday low of Rp18,270, with China's weak October data and higher external debt cited as drivers. (update of E0827)

event: The IHSG closed down 0.44% at 5,320.98 on 16 November, snapping the previous week's 5.82% rally, as basic-materials and energy stocks (AMMN, BRMS, BRPT, DEWA) dragged the index. (update of E0826)

event: FTSE Russell kept Indonesia as a Secondary Emerging Market and did not place it on a Watch List, but will remove stocks flagged for high shareholding concentration at its December review and freeze new additions and size changes until at least March 2027. (update of E0767)
key_numbers: 14 Indonesian stocks removed per CNBC headline (count not in the statement article) · removal effective 21 Dec 2026 · provisional list to 4 Dec, final 7 Dec · IPO/new additions delayed until at least the March 2027 review

event: Kemnaker's Industrial Relations director general Indah Anggoro Putri said under Law 27/2026 a government institution will centrally manage a severance reserve fund (dana cadangan pesangon) that employers must start depositing by October 2027, while Danantara denied being appointed to manage it.

event: Danantara plans to publish its first public financial report, for fiscal 2025, tentatively on 23 November 2026, after BPK finished its audit, according to COO Dony Oskaria.

key_numbers: 3 measures · more than 34 million individual capital-market investors

key_numbers: Q2 2026 deficit US$0.9 B · release Fri 20 Nov 2026, time not stated

event: MPR Chairman Ahmad Muzani said the MPR plenary to elect a new Vice President is postponed one week, from 2 December to Wednesday 9 December 2026, because President Prabowo's state schedule is very busy and he needs time to weigh the two candidates. (update of E0805)

event: A Gerindra East Jakarta branch chair, Ali Lubis, publicly backed DPR Deputy Speaker Sufmi Dasco Ahmad as the new Vice President, while PAN chair Zulkifli Hasan said nearly all coalition parties did not propose a candidate and agreed the pick should come from Gerindra. (update of E0833)

event: KPK said it has summoned Bea Cukai official Ahmad Dedi (Dedi Congor), a named suspect in the customs bribery case, twice and he cited illness each time; KPK investigators say they have seen no proof he is sick and are considering other measures.
key_numbers: 2 summonses · travel ban requested 23 Oct 2026, 6 months · KPK initial loss estimate in the related cigarette-excise probe: 'trillions of rupiah' · related Tipikor sentences: Rizal 9 yrs, Sisprian 7 yrs, Orlando 6 yrs

event: Kejagung scheduled Bekasi Mayor Tri Adhianto for questioning as a witness on 17 November in the alleged corruption case over BUMD PT Migas Kota Bekasi and its joint operation (KSO) with Pertamina EP; no suspects have been announced.

event: KPK said it respects the Supervisory Board (Dewas) and Inspectorate examining KPK staff over indications that documents in the ATR/BPN HGB bribery case were leaked, while KPK says it found signs of other land-service cases involving private parties beyond PT Summarecon.

event: Polri said ex-Kapolri Listyo Sigit Prabowo, a named suspect in the alleged illegal wiretapping of the President, will face a Polri ethics commission (KKEP) hearing because he is still an active member; the panel is chosen by Kapolri Suyudi Ario Seto, with no date set and 'next week' given for other suspects.

event: Counterpoint Research said the share of Indonesian smartphone sales priced under US$150 fell from 55% in Q3 2025 to 24% in Q3 2026 as RAM prices rose, making phones under Rp2 million hard to find. (update of E0787)
